# Data Model: Video Thumbnail Changer

**Generated by**: /speckit.plan | **Date**: 2026-04-10

---

## VideoFile

Represents a video file loaded into the application for thumbnail editing.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `path` | `str` | Absolute filesystem path to the video file |
| `format` | `VideoFormat` | Detected container format (see enum below) |
| `duration_ms` | `int` | Total video duration in milliseconds (≥0) |
| `width` | `int` | Video stream pixel width |
| `height` | `int` | Video stream pixel height |
| `existing_thumbnail` | `PIL.Image \| None` | Current embedded cover-art image, or `None` if absent |
| `is_writable` | `bool` | Whether the file is writable by the current user |

**Validation rules**:
- `path` must reference an existing file on a locally reachable filesystem.
- `duration_ms` must be > 0; an audio-only file or zero-duration file is rejected.
- `width` and `height` must be > 0 (presence of at least one video stream required).
- `is_writable` is evaluated at load time; if `False`, the Apply Thumbnail button is
  disabled and the error reason is displayed.

**State transitions**:
```
[no file] ──drop valid file──> [loaded]
[loaded]  ──drop new file──>   [loaded]   (silent replace, no confirmation)
[loaded]  ──apply succeeds──>  [loaded]   (existing_thumbnail updated)
[loaded]  ──apply fails──>     [loaded]   (unchanged; error shown)
```

---

## VideoFormat

Enum of supported container formats.

| Member | Container | Cover art support |
|--------|-----------|------------------|
| `MP4` | MPEG-4 Part 14 | `covr` atom — full (all platforms) |
| `MOV` | QuickTime | `covr` atom — full (all platforms) |
| `MKV` | Matroska | Attachment track — partial (Linux full; Windows/macOS via media players) |
| `AVI` | Audio Video Interleave | RIFF INFO chunk — best-effort; XDG cache on Linux |
| `WEBM` | WebM (Matroska subset) | Attachment track — partial (same as MKV) |
| `FLV` | Flash Video | None — XDG cache only on Linux |
| `UNSUPPORTED` | Any other extension / corrupt header | Not supported |

---

## TimelinePosition

A point in time within the loaded video, used to identify which frame to extract.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `offset_ms` | `int` | Millisecond offset from the start of video (0 ≤ offset_ms ≤ duration_ms) |

**Validation rules**:
- `offset_ms` must be ≥ 0 and ≤ `VideoFile.duration_ms`.
- Boundary values (0 and `duration_ms`) are valid; frame extraction must succeed at both.

**Derived value**:
- `fraction`: `offset_ms / duration_ms` — used to position the timeline scrubber widget
  (range [0.0, 1.0]).

---

## ThumbnailFrame

A single still image extracted from a `VideoFile` at a given `TimelinePosition`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `image` | `PIL.Image` | Decoded video frame as an RGB PIL Image |
| `source_position` | `TimelinePosition` | The timeline position from which this frame was extracted |
| `width` | `int` | Pixel width (≤ source video width; may be scaled for preview) |
| `height` | `int` | Pixel height (≤ source video height; may be scaled for preview) |

**Notes**:
- Frames stored for preview purposes are down-scaled to fit the preview widget (max 1280×720
  for display). This does not affect the full-resolution frame embedded into the video file.
- The full-resolution frame is extracted and held in memory only during the apply operation;
  it is not stored as a field on this entity.

---

## ApplyOperation

Represents a single invocation of the "Apply Thumbnail" action, encapsulating the inputs,
execution state, and result.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `video_file` | `VideoFile` | The video file to be modified |
| `selected_position` | `TimelinePosition` | The timeline position of the frame to embed |
| `status` | `ApplyStatus` | Current status of the operation (see enum below) |
| `result` | `ApplyResult \| None` | Populated when status is `SUCCEEDED` or `FAILED` |

### ApplyStatus enum

| Member | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `PENDING` | Not yet started (pre-confirmation dialog) |
| `IN_PROGRESS` | Write is in progress; controls are disabled |
| `SUCCEEDED` | Write and cache refresh completed successfully |
| `FAILED` | Operation failed; video file is unmodified |

---

## ApplyResult

The outcome of a completed `ApplyOperation`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `success` | `bool` | `True` if thumbnail was embedded and cache refreshed |
| `error_code` | `ApplyError \| None` | Machine-readable failure reason; `None` on success |
| `error_message` | `str \| None` | Human-readable failure description with corrective action; `None` on success |
| `elapsed_ms` | `int` | Total wall-clock duration of the operation in milliseconds |

### ApplyError enum

| Member | Cause | Suggested user action |
|--------|-------|----------------------|
| `FILE_NOT_WRITABLE` | File is read-only or on a read-only volume | Copy the file to a writable location |
| `FILE_LOCKED` | File is open by another process | Close any application using the file |
| `UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT` | Container format not in supported list | Convert the file to MP4 or MKV first |
| `NO_VIDEO_STREAM` | File has no video stream (audio-only) | Select a file with a video track |
| `FFMPEG_ERROR` | ffmpeg subprocess returned a non-zero exit code | Check disk space and file integrity |
| `DISK_FULL` | Not enough space for the temp file | Free disk space and retry |
| `UNEXPECTED` | Any unclassified error | Report the issue with the error details shown |

---

## Entity Relationships

```
VideoFile  ──1──>──1── VideoFormat
VideoFile  ──1──>──0..1── ThumbnailFrame   (existing thumbnail)

TimelinePosition  ──used by──>  FrameExtractor   (to extract candidate frame)
ThumbnailFrame    ──used by──>  ThumbnailWriter   (to embed cover art)

ApplyOperation ──has──> VideoFile
ApplyOperation ──has──> TimelinePosition
ApplyOperation ──has──> ApplyResult (after completion)
```
